components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array

            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message

          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.

          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          minLength: 1

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields

      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR); when present it is prepended to the salutation."
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "Structured address, first line (street). When supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address' field."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "Structured address, optional second line (unit, level). Appended to addressLine1 in the composed address when present."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Flat form, kept for backward compatibility; on read it is the composed normalized structured address when structured fields were supplied."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postal code; when present must be within the city's region range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), any 4-digit value for a city with no known region."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'

          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:

          format: email
          maxLength: 255

          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date

          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household

    Owner:

              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true

              title: Telephone display

              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:

              description: Server-assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true

              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4

              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same last name and address.

              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true

              title: Identity key
              description: "Derived duplicate-detection key: normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. A create is rejected 409 only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's."

              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|H-1A2B3C4D'

              description: Server-derived identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', YY being the last two digits of the registrationDate year.

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:

              description: "Points set at create time: +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, +3 for tenure over 365 days."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR); when present it is prepended to the salutation."
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "Structured address, first line (street). When supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address' field."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "Structured address, optional second line (unit, level). Appended to addressLine1 in the composed address when present."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Flat form, kept for backward compatibility; on read it is the composed normalized structured address when structured fields were supplied."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postal code; when present must be within the city's region range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), any 4-digit value for a city with no known region."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner, stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: Optional date of birth; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered; defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The title followed by a space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title is given."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Server-assigned identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code, the two-digit fiscal year, the first eight upper-hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D45'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same last name and address.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "Derived duplicate-detection key: normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. A create is rejected 409 only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|H-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Server-derived identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', YY being the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive) at create time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Points set at create time: +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, +3 for tenure over 365 days."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level from 1 to 4 derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "IANA timezone name derived from the region via a fixed table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane)."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True once more than 80 owners have already been created today, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "Age band derived from birthDate relative to registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+); absent when birthDate is not supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "Fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it starts in."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
